name: Scrape Amazon best-sellers to pick an import product
one_liner: Scrape Amazon best-seller lists by category, find high-rank/low-review gaps, then source the item on Alibaba and sell it on Amazon.
offer: An imported, slightly improved version of a best-seller
how_it_makes_money: Retail margin; presenter's worked example: ~$7 landed, $10–15 Amazon fees, ~$9 (30%) net on a $30 item
evidence: Worked example: $1.50–2 product, ~$7 landed, $16–21 all-in cost, ~$9 net per $30 sale (30%) – CKRglRCeVDM
Signal: high best-seller rank with low review count means 'a land grab is still in progress' – CKRglRCeVDM
'One-star test': if ~40% of one-star reviews share a defect, fix it and sell at the same price – CKRglRCeVDM

name: Custom photo magnets at weddings and markets

evidence: $1.63M revenue in the first full year; best month $233,000 – N0NceZbY2_4

how_it_makes_money: Per-job pricing (~$4.50 per line plus arrows and signs); first month ~75% profit doing the work himself
startup_cost: low – started with just over $3,000 (a $20 roller works for a first job)

name: Buy into an overlooked service franchise
one_liner: Buy a franchise in an unglamorous service niche (e.g. private insurance adjusting) using SBA-style financing.
offer: A proven franchise system with training and a peer group
how_it_makes_money: Service revenue (adjusters take a percentage of the claim)
startup_cost: medium–high – often up to 90% financed with an SBA loan
evidence: Guest: for one adjusting franchise 'their average revenue is $2.6 million per person' off a ~$5,000 start – t2m_Dqk4_Dc
Most franchises can be funded with an SBA loan at up to 90% financing – t2m_Dqk4_Dc

name: Founder newsletter grown with paid subscriber acquisition
one_liner: Grow a niche newsletter by paying for subscribers (Facebook ads, Beehiiv Boosts) and monetise it with sponsors and high-ticket offers such as events.
customer: Readers in a valuable niche (e.g. startup founders); sponsors
offer: A weekly email newsletter plus paid offers (sponsorships, a $10,000 mastermind)
how_it_makes_money: Sponsorships, events/masterminds and other offers; subscriber acquisition paid per subscriber
startup_cost: medium – the guest spent ~$6,000/month on acquisition
evidence: Guest turned a weekly newsletter into about half a million dollars in revenue; ~120,000 subscribers, mainly startup founders – 4AWlBGVQ8nA

name: Liquidation and overstock reselling

offer: Discounted goods sold through a store and marketplaces

name: Dehydrated colostrum and dried-food products
one_liner: Buy cheap raw farm or grocery produce (colostrum, fruit), dehydrate it and sell the higher-value product.
how_it_makes_money: Spread: colostrum bought at $3.20/gallon gives ~2.5 lb of powder sold at $20/lb (~$46)
evidence: Buys colostrum at $3.20/gallon from dairy farmers and sells the powder to other dairy farmers at $20/lb – RaFPcXDFObM
A dehydrated-fruit seller made $50,000 part-time and is on track for $100,000 net next year, growing from one dehydrator to ten – RaFPcXDFObM
